source("_setup.R")

  add_bars(
    y = ~Colleges,
    name = "Colleges Fielded",
    text = ~paste0(Colleges, " schools"),
    textposition = "inside",
    insidetextanchor = "middle",

    marker = list(
      color = "#2563eb",
      line = list(color = "#1d4ed8", width = 1.5)
    ),
    hovertemplate = "<b>Year %{x}</b><br>Colleges: %{y}<extra></extra>"
  ) |>
  add_lines(
    y = ~Athletes,
    name = "National Competitors",
    yaxis = "y2",
    line = list(color = "#e11d48", width = 3.5),
    marker = list(color = "#e11d48", size = 8),
    text = ~paste0(Athletes, " athletes"),
    textposition = "top center",
    textfont = list(color = "#be123c", size = 12, family = "sans-serif"),
    mode = "lines+markers+text",
    hovertemplate = "<b>Year %{x}</b><br>Athletes: %{y}<extra></extra>"
  ) |>
  layout(
    title = list(
      text = "<b>NAIA Women's Wrestling Participation Surge (2019–2026)</b>",
      font = list(size = 17, color = "#0f172a", family = "Montserrat, sans-serif")
    ),
    xaxis = list(

      titlefont = list(size = 13, color = "#334155")
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "<b>Colleges Fielded (Bars)</b>",
      titlefont = list(color = "#1d4ed8", size = 13),
      tickfont = list(color = "#1d4ed8", size = 12),
      range = c(0, 55),
      gridcolor = "#f1f5f9"
    ),
    yaxis2 = list(

      titlefont = list(color = "#e11d48", size = 13),

      showgrid = FALSE

      orientation = "h",

      font = list(size = 12)
    ),
    plot_bgcolor = "#ffffff",

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
## 📋 Note on 2023 Tournament Data
Official match-by-match bout logs and participant counts for the **2023 National Championship** were not available in the public tournament archives, so 2023 numbers are omitted from the timeline (similarly, the 2020 tournament was cancelled nationwide due to COVID-19).
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple"}
## 🏫 Why School Numbers Shifted After 2022
Between 2022 and 2024, the tournament transitioned from an **open national invitational** to an **official championship sport**. In the open era (2019–2022), any school could enter multiple athletes, leading to an uncapped peak of 40 colleges in 2022. Beginning in 2024, NAIA instituted **strict conference qualifying tournaments** and capped brackets at 20 wrestlers per weight class, so only the top ~35–36 schools with automatic conference qualifiers advance to nationals.
:::
:::
